structural-causal.name: bottleneckControl
structural-causal.basis: specialty construction/self-perform capacity is required to convert grid and load-center capex into energized infrastructure

structural-causal.name: scenarioRobustness
structural-causal.basis: demand spans utilities, generation and load centers rather than a single customer

structural-causal.name: substitutionResilience
structural-causal.basis: technology choices can change, but physical interconnection, transmission and distribution work remains necessary; project deferral remains a substitute for near-term spend

discovery-weak-signals.name: grid and load-center infrastructure exposure
discovery-weak-signals.basis: rapid revenue growth and record backlog indicate sustained demand for grid, generation and load-center construction capacity

adversarial-red-team.name: concentration risk
adversarial-red-team.basis: current 10-Q reports no >=10% revenue or receivable customer

adversarial-red-team.name: execution risk
adversarial-red-team.basis: large projects and rapid scaling can create margin and working-capital volatility

expectations-execution.name: execution and earnings conversion
expectations-execution.basis: revenue growth translated into substantially higher GAAP and adjusted per-share earnings

items.risk: Large-project execution, skilled-labor availability and customer capital-program timing can create delivery volatility.
Acquisition activity and project mix can make headline growth less comparable across periods.
Skilled-labor, permitting, customer capex timing and large-project execution can shift the bottleneck from demand to delivery capacity.
Backlog is not equivalent to risk-free future revenue; project timing, customer financing and execution can alter conversion.
Acquisitions and project mix can obscure organic comparability and margin durability.

edges.mechanism: delivery capacity converts contracted infrastructure demand into revenue and earnings
edges.falsifier: sustained revenue growth fails to produce earnings/cash conversion because execution costs absorb scale benefits

edges.mechanism: more simultaneous large projects increase labor, scheduling and working-capital demands
edges.falsifier: Quanta sustains margin/cash conversion while backlog scales without material execution slippage
